NetBird

开源零信任网络平台

基于 WireGuard® 的安全私有网络，无需复杂配置，即刻连接您的所有设备

立即开始

核心特性

🔒

零信任安全

采用零信任网络架构，支持 SSO 单点登录和 MFA 多因素认证，提供细粒度的访问控制，确保每个连接都经过验证和授权。

⚡

点对点连接

基于 WireGuard® 的端到端加密隧道，设备间直接通信，无需中继服务器，提供最佳性能和最低延迟。

🎯

极简配置

无需打开端口、配置复杂防火墙规则或部署 VPN 网关，几分钟内即可建立安全的私有网络。

🌐

跨平台支持

支持 Linux、Windows、macOS、iOS、Android 等所有主流平台，一次配置，随处连接。

🔓

完全开源

100% 开源项目，代码透明可审计，可自主部署或使用云托管服务，数据完全由您掌控。

🚀

企业级功能

支持访问控制列表、网络路由、DNS 管理、活动日志等企业级功能，满足各种规模组织的需求。

快速开始

1

注册账户

访问 netbird.io 使用您的身份提供商（如 Gmail、GitHub）快速注册

2

安装客户端

在需要连接的设备上下载并安装 NetBird 客户端

3

自动连接

客户端自动建立加密隧道，设备即刻安全互联

Open Source Zero Trust Networking

Secure private networks powered by WireGuard®. Connect all your devices without complex configuration.

Get Started

Key Features

🔒

Zero Trust Security

Built on Zero Trust principles with SSO, MFA, and granular access controls. Every connection is verified and authorized.

⚡

Peer-to-Peer

WireGuard®-based encrypted tunnels enable direct device-to-device communication for optimal performance and minimal latency.

🎯

Zero Configuration

No port forwarding, complex firewall rules, or VPN gateways needed. Set up secure private networks in minutes.

🌐

Cross-Platform

Native support for Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Configure once, connect everywhere.

🔓

Fully Open Source

100% open source with transparent, auditable code. Self-host or use our cloud service. Your data, your control.

🚀

Enterprise Ready

Access control lists, network routing, DNS management, activity logs, and more for organizations of any size.

Quick Start

1

Sign Up

Visit netbird.io and sign up using your identity provider like Gmail or GitHub

2

Install Client

Download and install NetBird client on devices you want to connect

3

Auto-Connect

Clients automatically establish encrypted tunnels and securely connect your devices
